nl: Run the unit tests of the project in pricing/ (python -m unittest discover -s tests, run inside pricing/) and name the failing tests.
oracle_program: test.run "pricing" framework: unittest |> filter status == "failed" |> select name
reference_bash: cd pricing && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | grep -E '\.\.\. (FAIL|ERROR)$'
reference_pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
Set-Location pricing; & $py -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" } | Select-String '\.\.\. (FAIL|ERROR)$'
